name: evaluate_time_skill
description: Estimate training wall-time for a proposed experiment config by (1) computing total step count from sample_set + seg_size + batch_size + epochs, (2) measuring ms/step via a real-dataset GPU warmup, (3) applying a learned per-GPU correction factor and a safety multiplier. Returns feasibility verdict vs time_budget_minutes. Must be called AFTER evaluate_resource_skill and BEFORE training_skill.

model_type.description: The model architecture (any model in MODEL_REGISTRY).

model_config.description: Model configuration dict (same as passed to training_skill).

train_config.description: Training configuration dict — batch_size, epochs, device.

sample_set.description: Training SampleSet — {file_index (str): [PSD segment indices]}. Used to compute total step count and to build the 1-PSD mini dataset for the warmup.

train_portion.description: Per-epoch subsampling fraction (0.01–1.0). Scales total step count.

time_budget_minutes.description: Maximum allowed wall-time for training in minutes. The skill returns feasible=false if the estimate exceeds this.

data_dir.description: Directory with abra_training_XXXX.h5 files. Required for real-dataset warmup; omit to force static-formula fallback.
